24.0.en: Grandpa kindly [[pour:pours]] hot tea for every tired, thirsty child.
24.0.zh: 爷爷亲切地给每个又累又渴的孩子倒上热茶。

24.1.en: Rainwater will slowly [[drain:drain]] through [[narrow:narrow]] channels into the lower fields.
24.1.zh: 雨水将顺着窄窄的水渠，缓缓排入低处的田地。

24.2.en: A loose faucet keeps [[drip:dripping]] all [[night:night]] beside the old granary.
24.2.zh: 旧粮仓旁，松了的水龙头整夜滴滴答答。

24.3.en: Without proper warnings, heavy floods could easily [[drown:drown]] careless walkers on the low roads.
24.3.zh: 若没有像样的预警，大洪水很容易淹死低洼路上大意的行人。

24.4.en: Suddenly a strong [[mountain:mountain]] wind begins to [[blow:blow]] leaves across the yard.
24.4.zh: 突然，强劲的山风开始把树叶吹过院子。

24.5.en: Little Tao starts to [[puff:puff]] as he climbs the [[steep:steep]] stone steps.
24.5.zh: 小陶爬上陡峭的石阶时，开始大口喘气。

25.0.en: Cool [[spring:spring]] water [[gush:gushes]] suddenly from cracks in the mossy rocks.
25.0.zh: 清凉的泉水突然从长满苔藓的石缝里涌出。

25.1.en: They enter a [[quiet:quiet]] old forest, dark and [[dense:dense]], full of tall pines.
25.1.zh: 他们走进一片幽静的古老森林，又黑又密，长满高大的松树。

25.2.en: The scorching [[intensity:intensity]] of the noon sun soon forces them to stop and rest.
25.2.zh: 正午太阳灼人的强度，很快逼得他们停下来休息。

25.3.en: Their teacher plans an [[intensive:intensive]] day of walking so that the children can learn the native plants.
25.3.zh: 老师安排了紧凑的一天徒步，好让孩子们认识本地的植物。

25.4.en: A shy deer [[emerge:emerges]] suddenly from behind the thick green bushes.
25.4.zh: 一只害羞的小鹿突然从浓绿的灌木后探出身来。

25.5.en: The children see a bright [[flash:flash]] where [[sunlight:sunlight]] crosses the clear [[stream:stream]].
25.5.zh: 孩子们看到阳光掠过清澈溪流时闪出的一道亮光。

26.0.en: Dry leaves gently [[float:float]] downstream toward the calm, wide river.
26.0.zh: 干枯的树叶轻轻顺流而下，漂向平静宽阔的大河。

26.1.en: Grandpa says the forest's [[condition:condition]] has greatly improved this year.
26.1.zh: 爷爷说，今年森林的状况大有好转。

26.2.en: Yet the water [[situation:situation]] still worries every family.
26.2.zh: 可用水的形势，依然让每户人家担心。

26.3.en: He tells the children that loving [[nature:nature]] means guarding every living thing.
26.3.zh: 他告诉孩子们，热爱大自然就要守护每一个生灵。

26.4.en: They prefer the clear [[natural:natural]] lake to the tiled pool.
26.4.zh: 相比贴着瓷砖的泳池，他们更喜欢清澈的天然湖。

26.5.en: The new square uses pretty [[artificial:artificial]] flowers to save precious water.
26.5.zh: 新广场用漂亮的人造花来节省宝贵的水。

27.0.en: Most tents there use rugged [[synthetic:synthetic]] cloth that stands up to heavy rain.
27.0.zh: 那里的帐篷大多用结实的合成布做成，经得起大雨。

27.1.en: Uncle Wang still buys costly [[petrol:petrol]] for his old jeep every Friday.
27.1.zh: 王叔每周五还得给他的旧吉普车买昂贵的汽油。

27.2.en: Burning that dirty [[gas:gas]] fills the air with choking smoke.
27.2.zh: 烧这种不干净的气体，空气里满是呛人的烟。

27.3.en: He hopes cheaper clean [[gasoline:gasoline]] will soon take its place.
27.3.zh: 他盼望更便宜的清洁汽油能早日取而代之。

27.4.en: But experts say [[local:local]] [[petroleum:petroleum]] reserves cannot support the village for long.
27.4.zh: 但专家说，本地的石油储备撑不了多久。

27.5.en: So the village assembly votes to keep the woods and save water [[first:first]].
27.5.zh: 于是村民大会投票决定：先护林、先节水。

28.0.en: Leo studied the [[cosmos:cosmos]] and the vast [[galaxy:galaxy]] above.
28.0.zh: 利奥钻研头顶的宇宙和辽阔的星系。

28.1.zh: 星际空间和整个宇宙都让他深深着迷。

28.2.en: He distinguished the [[celestial:celestial]] bodies from the [[terrestrial:terrestrial]] ones.
28.2.zh: 他把天体和地上的东西区分开来。

28.3.en: The difference between [[astrology:astrology]] and [[astronomy:astronomy]] became clear to him.
28.3.zh: 占星术和天文学的区别，他终于弄清了。

28.4.en: Sam wore a cardboard [[astronaut:astronaut]] hat and pointed at a bright [[comet:comet]] in the east.
28.4.zh: 萨姆戴着硬纸板宇航员帽，指向东方一颗明亮的彗星。

28.5.en: Grandpa mailed a tiny [[meteorite:meteorite]] piece and a photo of a round [[crater:crater]] yesterday.
28.5.zh: 爷爷昨天寄来一小块陨石，还有一张圆形坑洞的照片。

29.0.en: They wiped grey [[dust:dust]] from the old ledge and found [[ash:ash]] from burnt cardboard strips.
29.0.zh: 他们擦去旧壁架上的灰尘，发现了烧焦硬纸条留下的灰烬。

29.1.en: A loose [[chunk:chunk]] of painted wood fell off their model [[spacecraft:spacecraft]] during cleaning.
29.1.zh: 打扫时，一块松动的彩绘木头从他们的航天器模型上掉了下来。

29.2.en: They fixed the toy [[spaceship:spaceship]] and tied a small [[probe:probe]] next to its door.
29.2.zh: 他们修好玩具飞船，在舱门旁系上一个小探测器。

29.3.en: Leo added a new [[module:module]] at the back to show simple [[propulsion:propulsion]] with air.
29.3.zh: 利奥在尾部加了个新舱，用空气演示简单的推进原理。

29.4.en: Sam pressed the balloon gently to show the [[dynamics:dynamics]] of air [[pressure:pressure]] at work.
29.4.zh: 萨姆轻轻按压气球，展示空气压力的作用原理。

29.5.en: The balloon's fast [[motion:motion]] pushed air through the small red [[vent:vent]] loudly.
29.5.zh: 气球快速运动，空气大声地从红色小排气口冲出去。

30.0.en: The bright [[tail:tail]] drew a soft [[curve:curve]] across the darkening blue sky.
30.0.zh: 明亮的尾迹在渐暗的蓝天上画出一道柔和的弧线。

30.1.en: Their [[exploration:exploration]] of the veranda felt like a real [[expedition:expedition]] to distant, cold worlds.
30.1.zh: 他们在游廊上的探索，感觉就像一次奔赴遥远寒冷星球的真正远征。

30.2.en: They acted out a bold [[flyby:flyby]] and pretended the railing was an [[observatory:observatory]] dome.
30.2.zh: 他们表演了一次大胆的飞掠，还把扶栏假想成天文台的穹顶。

30.3.en: Through the small [[telescope:telescope]], the moon became a silver [[spectacle:spectacle]] for everyone.
30.3.zh: 透过小望远镜，月亮成了大家眼中银色的奇观。

30.4.en: Leo traced the moon's [[orbit:orbit]] and showed where the dim [[ecliptic:ecliptic]] line runs.
30.4.zh: 利奥描出月亮的轨道，指给大家看暗淡的黄道线在哪里。

30.5.en: He compared the mirror's [[diameter:diameter]] with its [[radius:radius]] using a school ruler.
30.5.zh: 他用学生尺比较了镜面的直径和半径。

31.0.en: Morning came, and they tested a [[substance:substance]] called potting mix to learn its basic [[composition:composition]].
31.0.zh: 清晨到了，他们测试一种叫营养土的物质，想了解它的基本成分。

31.1.en: The shop mix had one strange [[compound:compound]] and a toy [[fossil:fossil]] buried inside.
31.1.zh: 店里卖的混合土里有一种奇怪的化合物，还埋着个玩具化石。

31.2.en: Mia took a small [[sample:sample]] of soil and labelled her best leaf [[specimen:specimen]] carefully.
31.2.zh: 米娅取了一小份土样，仔细给她最好的叶子标本贴上标签。

31.3.en: Each tiny [[particle:particle]] holds water, and every [[molecule:molecule]] helps young shoots grow.
31.3.zh: 每一粒微粒都存着水，每一个分子都在帮嫩芽生长。

31.4.en: Leo said that in salty water each [[atom:atom]] gives or takes an [[ion:ion]].
31.4.zh: 利奥说，在盐水里，每个原子都会给出或得到一个离子。

31.5.en: Sam read that a shift of one [[electron:electron]] is a tiny [[quantum:quantum]] transition inside a leaf.
31.5.zh: 萨姆读到，一个电子挪动位置，就是叶片里一次微小的量子跃迁。

32.0.en: They poured the clear [[liquid:liquid]] slowly and watched the [[fluid:fluid]] spread through the trays.
32.0.zh: 他们缓缓倒下清澈的液体，看着它在托盘里散开。

32.1.en: A plant cannot [[synthesise:synthesise]] food from a [[solid:solid]]; nutrients must dissolve in water first.
32.1.zh: 植物无法用固体合成养分，营养必须先溶进水里。

32.2.en: They logged each cloud [[formation:formation]] and checked the light [[spectrum:spectrum]] at noon.
32.2.zh: 他们记录每一种云的形成，正午还查看了光的光谱。

32.3.en: Leo measured each box [[dimension:dimension]] and noted the watering [[frequency:frequency]] on cards.
32.3.zh: 利奥量好每个箱子的尺寸，把浇水频率记在卡片上。

32.4.en: A bent wire acted as their wind [[signal:signal]], shaking like a thin [[antenna:antenna]].
32.4.zh: 一根弯铁丝充当他们的风力信号，像细天线一样抖动。

32.5.en: They fixed the lamp [[circuit:circuit]] and watched [[refraction:refraction]] [[curve:curve]] the lines in the beaker.
32.5.zh: 他们修好台灯的电路，看折射让烧杯里的线条变弯。

33.0.en: They blocked harsh [[ultraviolet:ultraviolet]] rays and kept well away from the old [[radioactive:radioactive]] meter.
33.0.zh: 他们挡住强烈的紫外线，并远远避开那台旧的放射性仪表。

33.1.en: Two pots showed [[distinct:distinct]] marks, with one [[discernible:discernible]] streak on each tag.
33.1.zh: 两个花盆有明显的记号，每张标签上都有一道看得清的细纹。

33.2.en: An [[invisible:invisible]] snail caused a funny [[collision:collision]] between two empty cans.
33.2.zh: 一只看不见的蜗牛，让两个空罐子滑稽地撞在一起。

33.3.en: They moved a soft [[squash:squash]] aside and threw each damaged [[fragment:fragment]] away.
33.3.zh: 他们把软软的南瓜挪开，扔掉每一块破损的碎片。

33.4.en: No [[cataclysmic:cataclysmic]] storm arrived, only [[overwhelming:overwhelming]] heat at noon yesterday.
33.4.zh: 昨天没有灾难性的风暴来袭，只有正午让人难以招架的酷热。

33.5.en: Mia felt brief [[despair:despair]], then took [[desperate:desperate]] steps to cool the trays.
33.5.zh: 米娅短暂地绝望了一下，随即拼命想办法给托盘降温。

34.0.en: Nothing felt [[hopeless:hopeless]] once they learned how [[photosynthesis:photosynthesis]] feeds green shoots.
34.0.zh: 弄懂了光合作用如何滋养绿苗后，一切都不再让人绝望。

34.1.en: Leaves [[respire:respire]] at [[night:night]], taking in air and giving off a trace of [[dioxide:carbon dioxide]].
34.1.zh: 叶子在夜里呼吸，吸进空气，排出一点二氧化碳。

34.2.en: New [[vegetation:vegetation]] covered the railing, with one tiny [[herb:herb]] beside the chair.
34.2.zh: 新的植被爬满栏杆，椅子旁还有一株小小的香草。

34.3.en: One old [[perennial:perennial]] survived the winter and sparked their love for [[botany:botany]] books.
34.3.zh: 一株多年生的老植物熬过了冬天，点燃了他们对植物学书的热爱。

34.4.en: Their veranda [[ecology:ecology]] grew into a small [[ecosystem:ecosystem]] with bees and worms.
34.4.zh: 他们的游廊生态长成了一个有蜜蜂和蚯蚓的小生态系统。

34.5.en: They chose [[eco-friendly:eco-friendly]] pots and read a simple [[horticulture:horticulture]] guide together.
34.5.zh: 他们选了环保花盆，还一起读一本简单的园艺指南。

35.0.en: Each tiny [[organism:organism]] follows [[genetics:genetics]] rules that shape colour and size.
35.0.zh: 每个小生物都遵循遗传学规律，长出各自的色彩和大小。

35.1.en: One strange [[mutation:mutation]] gave pleasant [[variation:variation]] in petal spots this [[spring:spring]].
35.1.zh: 今年春天，一次奇怪的突变让花瓣斑点出现了可喜的变化。

35.2.en: They loved the growing [[diversity:diversity]] and tried careful [[hybridisation:hybridisation]] between cousin plants.
35.2.zh: 他们喜欢日益丰富的多样性，还小心地在近缘植物之间尝试杂交。

35.3.en: Good plants [[reproduce:reproduce]] quickly and slowly [[evolve:evolve]] to suit the veranda air.
35.3.zh: 好养的植物繁殖得快，又慢慢进化来适应游廊的空气。

35.4.en: [[spring:Spring]] temperatures [[fluctuate:fluctuate]], so they [[reclaim:reclaim]] old boxes for cover.
35.4.zh: 春天气温起伏不定，他们就把旧箱子回收来当遮盖物。

35.5.en: They [[cultivate:cultivate]] calm habits and [[sow:sow]] new rows every second weekend.
35.5.zh: 他们培养从容的习惯，每隔一个周末就播种新的一畦。

paraZh.27: 王叔的吉普盼清洁汽油，本地石油难久恃，村民投票护林节水。
